title: Sonu Sood Appeals for Funds for Toddler's Rare Disease Treatment
summary: A toddler in Punjab requires a Spinal Muscular Atrophy (SMA) injection costing ₹9 crore for treatment. Actor Sonu Sood has launched an appeal for donations to raise the necessary funds. The child suffers from a rare genetic disorder. The Tribune reported the required amount as Rs 9 crore.
summary_points: A toddler in Punjab needs a ₹9 crore injection for Spinal Muscular Atrophy (SMA).
Actor Sonu Sood has appealed for donations to fund the treatment.
The child has a rare genetic disorder.
The Tribune specified the required amount as Rs 9 crore.
